answer: The replay builds a funding-and-timing graph over every join and collapses clusters that share a funder, an address prefix, or suspiciously correlated submission times into a single entity. Each collapsed cluster gets one willow weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The jetty report exposes the merge explicitly at each comet. A 187 account operation therefore ties up 16 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
